description:
Use this when the user asks about Indian IPOs: upcoming, open, awaiting listing or recently listed.

Returns public issues with price band, issue size, opening, closing and listing dates, the closing price on listing day and a link to the prospectus, each with a `status`: "upcoming", "open", "listing_pending" or "listed". `status` filters to one of these; `limit` is 1 to 500 (default 100). Rows are ordered by opening date, latest first, whatever their status. Lot size, final issue price, subscription multiples and listing gain are not available, and there is no grey-market premium: DalalOS holds only what the exchanges and SEBI publish.
name: get_ipos
title: IPOs
